BJP National President Nitin Naveen Visits Mahakal Temple

Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) National President Nitin Naveen visited the Mahakal temple in Ujjain. This was his first visit to the temple after assuming the role of national president. He participated in the Bhasma Aarti ceremony. Naveen stated that he had a significant wish he presented to the deity.
